General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging (Unless Bulk Packed)
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Dowel Pins for the Cam Shaft *Mounting Caps for the 1.6L/16V Engine.
*Mounting caps are half-moon shaped brackets that bolt on directly above the cam-shaft securing it in place
Complete Set
Requires 2 Per Side.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 12 – Pins
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Sidekick 1993 – 1998 1.6L/16V Engine
Geo Tracker 1993 – 1998 1.6L/16V Engine
